title: Already in the bank
question: Does a co-sponsor value a range that is already in Treasuries more than the same range promised (H-010's seed)? Read the Genius Lab's four challengers as a co-sponsor, a judge with the case open and the practitioner; then check the newest draft, V49, against every case line.
serves: North stars 3 and 4; Client Knowledge (the case's 'high degree of certainty', :91, :97-98; credibility with co-sponsors, :114-115), Investment Strategy, Portfolio Analysis
essence: Our IPS gives Laura's hope a number (the gift reaches its top about 97 times in 100) but her promise none, so we measured the ten cheques: in our model they are paid in full about 998 times in 1,000, the rare gap a few hundred dollars, and only in the recession the draft itself lists (yields lower before the 2027 purchase and the 2028 deposit halved) does that fall to about 98 in 100.

Fundraisers never announce a campaign goal until 40 to 100 percent of it is already in hand, which is the Lab's 'move the money first, then name the range' from the co-sponsors' own world, so we kept it and tied it to the moment that matters: before any co-sponsor hears a number.

The newest draft bent one sentence so that the catch in Laura's range no longer made sense; we voted a repair and one new sentence that prices the draft's own recession, paid for by cutting the 'shopping problem' line, which the pitch already says.
decided: 3-0: the Lab's A (move first, then name) SHARPENED with Kai's trigger, 'before any co-sponsor hears a number'; fundraisers' quiet phase is the exact parallel (Felix)

3-0: V49 P7 repaired with Felix's version: 'A range named on stocks has a catch: every fall comes off the gift, every rise past the top goes to Laura. So in January 2031, before any co-sponsor hears a number, Laura moves the promised half into Treasuries.' (+1 strict; the panicked manager goes: L-15's risk is greed in a boom, not panic)
2-1 (Amara, Felix; Kai for his own two-number clause): in P4 after the recession sentence, 'If it halves that deposit, our model bounces a cheque once in 66.' (+13; MODEL S9)

2-1 (Amara, Felix; Kai would cut P4's opener): paid by P1's 'The cheques are a shopping problem, not an investing one.' (-10); P9's 'we built it first' stays 3-0 after all three first picked it in round 2. V49 497 strict
B KILL for the IPS (FR park stands); C to the FR with the largest miss beside the median; D KILL 3-0
seeds: Where does V49 define 'a high degree of funding certainty' as a level, not a method (:97-98)? It lists failures and now prices one, but never says what level we call high (Felix)
Is S9's $5,032 median gap a ladder left unfinished in 2028 or thin reinvestment after 2033, and does keeping Laura's half to 2042 close it? (Kai)
In S9 the gift falls under the bottom co-sponsors heard in 20 paths of 200,000: what does Laura tell them, and when? (Amara)
